title: Form definition
description: A form for @whatsaaaa/form-builder-schema. Run validate() too: it also checks names, defaults, form rule paths and layout references.

then.title: Same as
then.description: Equals another field, e.g. to confirm a password

then.title: Different from
then.description: Differs from another field, e.g. a new password

then.title: Compare
then.description: Less or greater than another field, e.g. an end date after the start
